description: Inspired by the life and passions of one man and featuring a touch of the roaring twenties, 1926 Le Soleil Hotel & Spa offers luxurious rooms and suites in the central city of Sliema. The hotel is located 200 meters from the seafront and also offers a splendid 1926 La Plage Beach Club on the water’s edge as well as a luxury SPA. The beach club is located 200 meters away from the hotel and is a seasonal operation. Our concept of ‘Lean Luxury’ includes the following: • Luxury rooms at affordable prices • Uncomplicated comfort and a great sleep • Smart design technology • Raindance showerheads • Flat screens • SuitePad Tablets • Self check in and check out (if desired) • Coffee & tea making facilities

reviews.title: Hotel muito bom
reviews.text: The hotel is very pleasant and cool, and the room was comfortable. Alex was amazing and very helpful; he explained everything clearly and was very kind throughout our stay. The hotel offers access to a beach club, which is also excellent and great for enjoying the hotter days. I highly recommend staying at this hotel if you are visiting Malta.

reviews.title: Only Staff make it 5* but the hotel needs work!!
reviews.text:
Pros:
Would come back here purely for how great staff were! Reception staff were absolutely amazing! I’m frustrated I didn’t get their names at the end so I could give them the recognition they deserved but all the gentlemen staff were very attentive and polite and made an effort to learn visitors names and address them as such which I really appreciated!
Staff at the rooftop restaurant were also very attentive! I did manage to get Rajip’s name who was nothing short of incredible! Also gave great recommendations on things to do during my stay in Malta which was very helpful and overhead him giving the same level of service to other tables everytime I was there! Thank you Rajib and also reception staff whose names I  regrettably didn’t catch!.
Cons:
The fact that visitors have to pay to use the spa services at €40 per person for 1hour and half I think is pretty ridiculous. Considering I paid £1k+ for my stay here I think there should be complimentary free usage of spa services for a limited time per day. Yes, there’s a pool on the roof included in the stay which gets 0% shade and not the most comfortable in 30degress + weather. I also booked a room with the plunge pool on the balcony which is a foot bath at best! Very misleading.
Breakfast:
The al carte breakfast menu really isn’t great at all! I’ve seen 3* buffets with better menus. Having table service is great but at the cost of breakfast options and smaller sizes…not worth it.  Portions are small and limited. The waffles were lovely but you’re served a quarter of the waffle  and when I asked for eggs to have on the side I was told I had to pick. I didn’t make a fuss but the next day Rajip was kind of enough to offer me both which another newer member didn’t (not her fault it’s how things are and should change) if you want a full English you have to pay for it which I think is ridiculous. Everything on the menu should be included in breakfast with larger portions.
All in all staff and the Michelin star restaurant (minus breakfast) make it 5*. Hotel could do with lots of changes.

reviews.title: Hotel with pretensions and basic breakfast
reviews.text:
Hotel with pretensions and interesting details, but with incomprehensible service failures and a very basic breakfast buffet for the style of the hotel.
We asked for conditioner and body lotion and one day they gave it to us, two days later they denied it to us at the front desk saying that they didn't have any of that. The shower gel, hand soap, and shampoo are all the same product.
Out of seven days, they did turndown service for us twice and the rest of the time they didn't come by. It's incomprehensible and for several days we had to ask for products because they wouldn't refill them even seeing they were used up (tissues, tea bags...).
The beach club is very nice but the temperature of the pool is incomprehensible, it's like real broth. You can't enjoy it after 9:30.
The breakfast buffet is very sparse for this type of hotel. Every day they put out the same thing, varying the scrambled eggs (watery) and the potatoes. There is no live cooking and one day the cereal bread is missing, another day the chia... They don't pay much attention.
You can't call the four machines they have a gym. Two cardio machines, a couple of benches, and a pulley that can't be used because they don't have different grips. It's useless and they don't pay attention to it. A shame because the idea isn't bad.
Good for the daily water bottle, the spa, the terrace, and the beach club. Good for the waiters at Margaux and the guys at the Beach club.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text: We stayed in this hotel for 2 days. Overall, we were not very satisfied. The check-in process was quite bumpy, and we did not receive the room we had booked. However, they accommodated us, and we received another room. Nevertheless, in terms of amenities and service, it is not a 4-star experience as stated. There are noticeable signs of wear and tear on the furniture and decor, etc. Additionally, the rooms are quite noisy, and the constant shuffling above is clearly audible. One searches for consistency in this hotel. On one hand, it offers a very nice lobby and a lot in terms of sports and fitness facilities, as well as a beach club. But the rooms and the service lag behind. The location of the hotel is very good; it is less than a 10-minute walk to the ferry terminal to cross over to Valletta. Despite everything, the rooms are clean, and the staff was friendly. However, it is negatively noted that they only superficially addressed my husband's gluten allergy. We would have liked to add breakfast for 15 euros, but upon inquiry, we were only told that there is a bit of selection of gluten-free items. We experienced this very differently in Malta and Gozo, and even in 3-star hotels, there was always sufficient gluten-free food provided. The hotel should reflect on this, especially since Malta is a leader in gluten-free products, and locals are even state-supported if they are affected by celiac disease, as it is already difficult for those affected to be sure they are not poisoned.

reviews.title: Great staff but poor room and operations
reviews.text:
I would not recommend staying at this hotel. A male staff member entered my room at 9:30 PM without knocking or announcing themselves. After entering, they said they believed the room was vacant, which points to a serious lapse in communication and hotel operations and was a major violation of my privacy.
I was also assigned a room without a fridge and only learned this after checking in. The room itself was in unacceptable condition. The bathroom had a strong sewage odor, rusted fixtures, damaged walls, a toilet that would not flush properly, toothpaste stains left behind from a previous guest, and the curtains had visible food stains, raising serious concerns about cleanliness. The walls also provided very little sound insulation, making it easy to hear noise from both the hallway and neighboring rooms.
The customer service staff were friendly and professional, and location was convenient but they could not make up for the poor room condition, lack of privacy, and operational issues. Kindly note that both pools are closed by 6:30PM for travelers arriving later in the day. I would not stay here again.

reviews.title: They scam you to pay twice and use your bank card remotely without authorisation
reviews.text: I am only going to write about one thing - the scam they are practicing with your payment card. I see from another recent review I am not the only one. They take payments from your card without authorisation. They then claim you haven't made the payment and ask you to make it again at checkout. If you say you have already taken the money they dispute this and ask for proof. In my case I had fortunately seen on my Monzo account the money had gone prior to checkout and could send them a screenshot. They seemed to accept this and allowed me to depart. However they then tried 2 more times to take payments from my card whilst I was travelling home. I have had to get a replacement card. I have made a complaint to Jet2 but as my holiday has finished I have been diverted to an online complaint system instead of speaking to a person. All around a sour taste to what should have been a nice holiday.

reviews.title: Badly designed rooms massively let it down
reviews.text:
Great location, fantastic beach club and rooftop pool but badly let down by room design.  NO drawers whatsoever, one small rail (not even a single wardrobe) .  No mirror at design for doing hair and make up.   Large mirror other wide of room but no plugs nearby to plug in hairdryer.
Would not stay in this hotel again for these reasons.  We had clothes and 'stuff' all over the room because there was simply no place to put anything.

reviews.title: 1926 Hotel Selima   Malta
reviews.text:
Really super hotel a  5 star experience .
Staff are amazing can’t do enough for you .
Pool side and Champagne bar staff amazing especially Jayron who made us superb cocktails.
Always plentiful quiet corners to chill and relax.
The Champagne breakfast what can I say, again 5*
All freshly cooked to order.
A truly stunning hotel beautiful interior
and spotless throughout.

reviews.title: Great location and the Beachclub makes it a perfect place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week and had a great time. Perfect location for exploring Sleima and Valetta with just a 5 minute walk to the ferry. Lots of buses make it easy to travel to Mdina and Rabat. Room was lovely.  Balcony so small that it just fitted two chairs but still nice for an evening glass of wine or morning coffee. Friendly and helpful staff. Roof top pool only has limited space which has to be booked in advance so I suggest booking ASAP after arrival. Beachclub is a 5 minute walk and lots of sunbeds and a pool. Get there by 10.30,  or after 4 30pm. Food at the beachclub is really good.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, good location, few issues let it down
reviews.text:
Really nice hotel situated in a great location. Having never visited Malta before we didn’t really know the best place to base ourselves but this hotel worked perfect for us. Rooms were nice, although a bit on the small side and there wasn’t much clothes storage in our room. Really enjoyed the pool at the beach club, and the food and drinks from here were great. Didn’t try the rooftop pool due to the booking system, but I wouldn’t let this put you off as the beach club had plenty of beds. Whilst I enjoyed the music and the atmosphere at the pool, it was quite loud so if you were looking for a more relaxing pool Experince this could be an issue. The main issue with this hotel, which i have seen mentioned in previous reviews, was the payment on arrival. 5 days prior to arriving they charged my card for the night of the first stay. I was not aware this was going to happen so emailed the hotel and queried it. They told me that it wasn’t a charge it was a hold and no
Money has been taken, which wasn’t true. After back and forth they said they would put the money back on the car after we paid the full amount on check in. When we checked in they charged us the full amount, and never refunded the card. It took 3 days of us going back down to the reception to query why the original “deposit” hadn’t been refunded. To add to this the first 2 nights of our stay during the night random charges appeared on my card. The first was only £1 but the second was a random £80 charge. My card declined the payment so nothing was taken, but the hotel couldn’t explain why this had happened. Another thing to add was the staff who cleaned the rooms appeared to do this very late in the day, sometimes arriving at 5pm despite asking them multiple times prior in the day if they could do the room earlier, as we needed to get back in earlier on this particular evening. Didn’t affect us too much but definitely make sure to use the app to request the clean first thing in the day if you require this service. Overall a nice hotel and I would return, but the payment issues did cause some stress on holiday. It wouldn’t let us pay upfront, but if you do get the option for this I would take it to save the hassle.

reviews.title: Average hotel
reviews.text: Very mediocre hotel the room itself was fine , but we had a hotel with sea view unfortunately I did not enrich so I did not see the stripe of sea what would be seen . That was not the biggest problem there is a rooftop bar with swimming pool , which is one of the reasons why I booked this in a center , but this is only accessible with a reservation and works in time slots and these were all fully booked in our stay . In the evening it is also not open for a drink. That is a great pity if one cannot make use of it. I also found that it was in a bit of a muddy neighborhood with garbage bags everywhere etc. No it was not my thing and also after a night of trying to sleep ( I heard the neighbors snoring as if they were in my room ) booked another hotel and left . They wanted to arrange everything for us like other room because of the neighbors snoring. Access to other pool at another hotel . But no money back for the unslept days. But I was so sorry about the hotel that we took our loss and took a few more very nice days in another hotel

reviews.title: The best hotel experience in Malta
reviews.text: Wow this hotel is fantastic what a beautiful stay we have had . The staff are the most amazing staff Ive ever experienced. Big shout out and thank you to Santiago on reception hes is amazing so polite helpful and genuinely a lovely person he always helped us with any questions or requests we had also Min is one of the nicest bar staff I've ever met and so friendly. Mario in the upstairs pool area was great and really accommodating and helpful. They are just to name a few so many other wonderful staff. The hotel itself is gorgeous the rooms were spotless and cleaned to a high standard.I felt safe at all times very central to the harbour , shops restaurants and the buses . The spa is gorgeous. The food in the pool bar is lovely the guy behind the bar in the pool bar is also super friendly.The main event is the beach bar wow wow wow what an amazing experience just fantastic thanks everyone we will 100% be back from Karen and Chris Clarke

reviews.title: City break, sight seeing and food
reviews.text:
Arrived by car reception greeting good, went up to the room to be disappointed, it was very small, the bathroom in particular, basin was a cloakroom style basin very small, and the shower hinged inwards, which meant you had to cram yourself into a corner to close the door, very uncomfortable. Bed hard but not horrendous. All amenities there except a hair dryer. Again room very small.
Breakfast was a buffet, all staff friendly and attentive, but for me a huge failing is the use of powered eggs for the scrambled eggs, no other options for eggs, unless you asked for fried or poached and they happily made them fresh for you. Which was great, but not being given this as a choice or explained, I'd imagine people didn't know.
Two other things really bothered me, the first was free water, you arrive in your room and there is a bottle of water with Compliments, but with a note saying if you want more you will be charged for it. I find this outrageous, I've travelled all over the world and water has always been made available free of charge.
Lastly, checking out, we had a few pool side drinks and food so when I went to check out I was informed that the credit card that they took on arrival had been used and charged for all my items also any City tax that I needed to pay, asking why and could I not have used up my last cash euros, I was informed that a refund would take several days, nobody explained this before hand and not that it's a issue on my card, but I gave NEVER not being given an alternative method of payment before SHOCKING.

reviews.title: Don´t go there with children!!
reviews.text:
The hotel is absolutely unfriendly to children. Children are not allowed in the outdoor pool on the rooftop, nor in the gym. They are not even allowed when accompanied by their parents! That is hard to understand for parents and even more for the kids!! The SPA is only accessible with children during very limited hours in the morning and afternoon when you are normally on sightseeing trips.
The employee at the reception explained that this restriction is noticed somewhere on the hompage. Who is reading the conditions of the hotel on their homepage before booking? They sould mention during the booking process that they prefer to have adults only as their guests.

reviews.title: Great hotel but not a family hotel
reviews.text:
We've just had 3 nights at the hotel (3 generations, Inc kids aged 12&14). It has a lot of great points, the staff are amazing, the food was great and the location is very handy BUT it wasn't what we were expecting. From the Jet2 website it looked like a hotel that overlooked the sea and had 2 outdoor pools and an indoor pool (our Jet2 search criteria) which is why we booked it. However the big pool in the picture is a beach club which only opens in May and isn't attached to the hotel, the other outdoor pool is heated but adult only and the spa pool is very small and was only available to children 8-11am and 3-4pm. It was far from ideal. The other thing that isn't clear from the Jet2 website is that the hotel is in the middle of buildings and not next to the sea. We had 2 rooms, 1 looked straight onto apartment block balconies and the other faced the street, we had hoped for a balcony we could enjoy a drink on. The location is very handy for ferries, eateries, shops etc but is in the middle of the mêlée, not peaceful, overlooking the sea!
The other aspect that was a bit disappointing was the room itself, it was called a Family Suite but it wasn't a suite, it was a room with 2 big beds in it and a small bathroom. There was limited space for clothes, only hanging space (no drawers and and only 1 high shelf), there were 2 hooks for robes, not 4, no towel rail to hang wet towels, 2 chairs on the tiny balcony, there just wasn't enough space. It would be better to get rid of the 2nd big bed and put bunk beds in and add a chest of drawers. The room became very claustrophobic v quickly!
I feel bad putting this negative review but wish I'd known what we had booked before arriving. This is a lovely hotel for adults and I'd highly recommend it for adults, the rooftop bar is amazing, just leave the kids at home!

reviews.title: Lovely hotel, great staff.
reviews.text:
Gorgeous hotel. Exceptionally clean and maintained. Lovely breakfast menu, a self service buffet which was always replenished. We didn't eat in the evening as we wanted to try food from around the island. The gym was very clean and all machines worked. The spa was clean and well maintained. All staff were excellent -very friendly, polite and helpful.
The coffee/tea facilities in the room were good, there was even a Nespresso machine!  I drink tea but there were only small coffee cups so a teapot would have been better for me.
There were only two problems..there were no proper cupboards or wardrobes, just an open framework of shelving and a hanging rail. This wasn't enough for two people, meaning we had to store clothes in our suitcases. I like to put worn clothes back in my case throughout the stay but I was unable to do so.
The other is the corridors...they are tiled floors which are easy to keep clean and look very nice, but they are noisy at times as they echo when doors close and people wheel their suitcases along. A carpet might soften the noise.
On the whole, we had a great holiday and we would recommend this hotel.

The room was nice,  if on the small side, but it had a balcony.  The breakfast was tasty and plentiful. A lovely relaxing weekend,  even in the storms.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel amazing stay
reviews.text:
Stayed for 4 nights with my mother who is 80 years old, our tour operator had not informed the hotel that we wanted a twin room and a king size had been allocated; the hotel were quick to change this for us and it was actually an upgrade on a higher floor which was marvellous. The hotel is immaculately clean and well situated within walking distance to everywhere required.
We didn’t use the spa but it looked amazing, the staff are super friendly and go over and above to make you feel welcome, nothing is too much trouble. We ate at Margeaux’s most evenings and the presentation, taste and service was special.
Breakfast is buffet style and hot and plentiful.
Would stay again !!
Recommend to all

reviews.title: Malta for the First Time
reviews.text:
We just spent 3 1/2 weeks at this hotel. The reason we chose it was it had 2 bedroom apartments as part of their offerings. Unfortunately when we arrived we were booked into the wrong apartment and it took 2 days to get us moved to the apartment we requested. Having said that the hotel has many good things going for it. First of all the location is great. There are numerous restaurants within a 10 minute walk, same for 2 banks and a great pharmacy just 2 blocks away. 2 convenience stores and 2 grocery stores are also less than a 10 minute walk away as is the Point Shopping Centre.
Walking to the Strand either on the harbour side or the Mediterranean side is also a few minutes walk away and the ferry to Valetta is a 10 minute walk.
The hotel's amenities are good including a rooftop view with a terrific 360 view. There is also an indoor pool and spa. Both pools are on the small side and quite shallow, more for cooling off rather than swimming. The indoor pool is really more like a giant hot tub as it is quite narrow and heated to probably 80 or higher.
We only ate at Margaux and the food was quite good although we did find the menu to be a bit limited and it never changed in the entire time we were there.
The staff were eager to please and helpful. Occasionally a minor difficulty in communication but never a problem. A special shout out to Mohammed who took us to our room on that first day and then just seemed to keep an eye on us to make sure or stay went well.
Because we were there longer than most there were a few things to note. First is that it took 3 weeks to get the wifi in our apartment fixed. Until then we had to use the guest service option which was not as secure and often unstable so that was a frustration. The apartments themselves, while quiet and very clean they are sparsely furnished. For example in the 2 bedroom apartments there was 1 sofa, not sufficient for 4 people to sit on and not very comfortable. The kitchen was also quite sparse, so little things like salt and pepper, maybe some olive oil, napkins, oven mitts should be present but they were not. There is no direct phone from the apartment to the hotel so ether have to use the hotel app or use a cell phone to call the hotel directly, The hotel app is good but if you actually need to talk to someone then a phone call or go to the front desk is are the only options.

reviews.title: A Stay That Quietly Redefined Our Expectations — 1926 Le Soleil Hotel & Spa, Sliema
reviews.text:
There are hotels one merely tolerates, hotels one genuinely enjoys, and then the rare few that quietly rearrange one's sense of what hospitality can be. The 1926 Le Soleil Hotel & Spa in Sliema belongs firmly to the last category — and having now returned to the 1926 family for a second time, I can say without the faintest exaggeration that it ranks among the finest establishments I have ever had the pleasure of staying in.
From the very first day, the level of attention was nothing short of extraordinary. The staff were, in the truest sense, at our beck and call: scarcely a day passed without someone discreetly ensuring that all was well. On more than one occasion the telephone in our room rang, and it was reception, calling simply to ask whether we required anything at all — whether something might be brought up, arranged, or seen to. It is one thing to be looked after; it is quite another to be anticipated. We felt, frankly, spoiled — granted a kind of effortless VIP treatment that never once tipped over into intrusion.
The housekeeping team deserves particular praise. They were unfailingly warm and — a genuinely welcome surprise — every one of them spoke excellent English. This turned even the smallest logistics into a pleasure rather than a negotiation: we could agree on cleaning times, coordinate the replenishment of coffee capsules, and request fresh towels without the slightest friction.
Then there was the beach bar, where we spent several happy hours almost every single day, entirely free of charge. What so many hotels and resorts treat as a premium privilege — charging upwards of 25 EUR per person — was here simply part of the experience: comfortable loungers, parasols both by the sea and around the pool, and food that was, without overstatement, superb. I developed a particular weakness for the grilled salmon, served with crisp salad sides and fries, though the mussels were every bit its equal; my wife worked her way steadily through the menu over the course of our stay and pronounced every dish a delight. The cocktails, too, were sublime — and on one memorable occasion we were treated, entirely gratis, to drinks made from the local prickly-pear cactus. It was a charming gesture in itself, rendered all the more delightful by the fact that the drinks proved utterly remarkable.
A hotel cannot, of course, take credit for the weather — but it can take full advantage of it, and Le Soleil does so with real flair. Through the hotel's own app we discovered and booked a day-long cruise aboard the Hera II, a circumnavigation of Malta lasting some nine hours. The day encompassed not only snacks and a proper lunch but also diving at Golden Bay, swimming in the celebrated Blue Lagoon off the island of Comino, and bathing in the open sea, descending directly from the deck by ladder into deep water. It was an unforgettable experience — one we would almost certainly never have stumbled upon had it not been so seamlessly offered through the hotel's own platform.
Breakfast and dinner, taken in the hotel's Margaux restaurant, were consistently excellent: a generous and varied selection, unlimited helpings, and service of real warmth. One small detail captures the spirit of the place perfectly. On our very first morning, our waiter noted that I take my coffee with almond milk — and from that day forward he asked, entirely of his own accord, each and every morning, whether he should bring it prepared just so. That he remembered us at all was gratifying; that he had committed my preferences and dietary needs to memory was, quite simply, remarkable.
The spa was a haven. We rested thoroughly, though to our slight regret we never quite found the time to experience the massages first-hand — an omission we fully intend to remedy on our next visit, for return we most certainly shall. We did, however, make the most of the hotel's own pool and sauna, which offered a wonderfully intimate, understated, and private atmosphere — an excellent experience in every respect.
And finally — most important of all — the reception. Put plainly, it was the finest front-desk service we have ever encountered anywhere. The only team to rival it is that of the sister property, 1926 Les Bains, just across the street. These were people who not only remembered us from our previous stay a year earlier — and I mean genuinely remembered, for a receptionist recognised us, approached with a smile, welcomed us warmly, and told us how lovely it was to see us both again — but who were also tirelessly helpful, arranging our taxis to and from the airport, striking up genuinely enjoyable conversations, and forever asking whether there was anything further they could do. Beyond their professionalism, they were simply good company: good people, exactly where they belong.
1926 Le Soleil is, without hesitation, one of the very best hotels I have ever stayed in. We will be back.

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel is over the top- staff is amazing,  our room is clean,  spacious and comfortable.  A staff member comes around in the afternoon to see if you need anything- towels,  cleaning, etc.  The breakfast is the best we've had in all our travels. They have plenty of amenities,  most we didn't use because we aren't here long enough but they all look great.  Perfect location.  HIGHLY recommend.

reviews.title: Very good hotel BUT………
reviews.text:
This hotel is really very good. The staff are wonderful and the amenities great. The area it is located in is a little rundown. We booked a deluxe room which is no different to a standard room except that one wall is papered. A couple of minor points, the room was on the small side and the shower floor slippy and it was hard not to flood the bathroom when having a shower. There is little storage for your clothes which have to be kept on open shelving. All quite minor points really which taken together would still  mean a five star review.
However our experience on arrival needs to be noted so that others are aware. When we booked direct with the hotel we were told we could pay on arrival which we did. We were told that the payment hadn’t gone through and we were asked to pay again, which we did. We were again told that the payment hadn’t gone through so could we do it again ? I pointed out that the terminal had said approved on both occasions. A male member of staff ( slightly  more assertive ) asked us to check our banking app which we did and showed him that the payment had been taken (1900€) This wasn’t good enough he said as the payment said pending. We pointed out that this is normal banking procedure. Unfortunately the member of staff just wouldn’t listen. We were told we couldn’t have access to our room until we paid again. Obviously this was very upsetting, my husband then called the bank in the UK and had to have this personal conversation in a busy foyer. The bank assured us the payment had gone through. I eventually asked for a manager who did smooth things over, offering us complimentary drinks and a complimentary taxi for our return journey to the airport. However over the next couple of days we had calls from the fraud dept at our bank advising that the payment had indeed gone through twice but the bank had stopped the second payment due to fraud protocols. The main issue here is that the hotel would not accept that they had indeed tried to put the payment through twice saying that just wasn’t possible. So beware if you intend to pay on arrival as the hotel doesn’t  seem to understand how the international banking system works and you could potentially be left high and dry in a foreign country. This situation cast a nasty shadow on our holiday which was hard to overcome.

reviews.title: Ideal location in Sliema with extremely comfortable room and excellent customer service from all staff.
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at 1926 Le Soleil. It had a luxurious feel but was also relaxed.
The hotel was absolutely spotless, rooms cleaned each day with a turn down service in the evening.
The staff at reception, at breakfast, in the lobby bar, rooftop bar and beach club were so friendly and professional and willing to answer any questions and accommodate requests.
Despite its position in Sliema, it was relatively quiet. I didn’t eat in the restaurant in the evening as was out and about trying local restaurants. I had breakfast at the hotel a few times and it was good and plentiful.
Majority of bookings could be managed through the app, I didn’t have any problems booking sunbeds. Favourite part of hotel stay was the rooftop bar and beach club. Hotel extremely handy location, mins away from ferry to Valetta.
Would definitely stay again if in Malta.
Only criticisms would be lack of storage in room and towels looked a little tired. Like others have said, it would be nice if water was replenished each day but there is a supermarket nearby.

Pros: cleanliness, air conditioning worked perfectly. Breakfasts were good.

Good location.
I recommend it.

reviews.title: Great locations, amazing service would return
reviews.text:
Excellent service from all staff, so clean, great breakfast - all staff go above and beyond and service with a smile.  Great cocktails.  Spacious room which is cleaned daily.  Rooftop pool with drinks is slightly more expensive than first floor bar. If it’s about the experience and nice place for a lunch.  Reserve a space,
Lovely thick towels.  Did not score a 5 due to two  minor issues the large great sun beds are uncomfortable in the middle you need to sit to the side.  The cabana and other chairs are prefect.  The other issue was the shower was not very powerful had to use the lower one and at times the water was not hot which we assume was due to use.  Spa facilities were great and I enjoyed a wonderful massage

reviews.title: Great location but obsessed with its app
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is its best feature. The rooms are ok, if a little sparse and soulless, and we enjoyed the spa. The staff were friendly but it lacks a bit in genuine customer service because of an obsession with tech. You are directed to do pretty much everything through their app, including booking sun loungers by the rooftop pool (which, be warned, must be done before you arrive if you want to use them during the first few days of your trip).  It feels like a lot of admin for a holiday and takes away any sense of warmth and hospitality.

reviews.title: Never ever again...
reviews.text:
This was a very disappointing experience. I was initially assigned to an accessible room, which meant there was a lowered toilet and no shower curtain. When using the shower, it was not possible to position the shower head properly without flooding the entire bathroom. In addition, the air conditioning was not working.
On the second day, I returned to the room and noticed a number of insects on the bathroom floor. I took photos and later understood these to be baby cockroaches. At that point, I did not raise it immediately. However, when I later sat on the bed, I saw several large cockroaches moving around the room. I took photos and a video and went to reception. The staff member initially suggested sending housekeeping at 11pm to spray the room so that I could still sleep there.
After insisting, I was eventually moved to another room. However, I was asked whether I would return to the original room the following day due to reservations, which I declined.
The breakfast was enjoyable, but aside from the room change, no compensation, upgrade or alternative resolution was offered. Based on this experience, I would not stay here again.

reviews.title: Great relaxing stay
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed at this beautiful hotel for one week. The staff went above and beyond to help my friends and I have a lovely relaxing stay. The breakfast staff especially were very friendly and helpful and did their very best to make this stay great. Highly recommend this hotel to anyone staying in silema Malta!! Thank you for four Irish girls!! 🇮🇪
